announce.name: Alexa announcement
announce.description: Send a non-confidential MP3 to selected enabled Echo rooms.

init.title: Configure TAFA
init.description: Choose the area to configure. Everything except speech input/output is optional.

hardware.title: Speech servers & GPU
hardware.description: Piper runs in TAFA App (default) or on a Proxmox speech server. For Proxmox enter http://SERVER:5000; add CPU Whisper using Wyoming port 10300. Optionally connect Qwen at http://GPU-PC:10502. Piper remains fallback while GPU PC is off.

data.piper_base: Piper server URL (TAFA local or Proxmox :5000)
data.gpu_stt_host: GPU host for fast reachability probe

data_description.piper_base: Keep the internal default for all-in-one. Proxmox server: http://SERVER-IP:5000
data_description.cpu_stt: Only for external Wyoming Whisper; otherwise use bundled TAFA Whisper.
data_description.hardware_profile: Automatic: prefer GPU Qwen, with Piper fallback. CPU: always Piper.
data_description.gpu_base: Qwen Stream on the separate GPU worker, port 10502. Leave blank to disable GPU TTS.

announcements.title: Alexa announcements & HTTPS (optional)
announcements.description: Only needed for Alexa announcements via MP3. Proxmox generator: http://SERVER:5001; public HTTPS audio host via separate Nginx proxy serving speech server port 8080. For tablet→Echo Bluetooth leave empty.

data_description.rooms_json: JSON mapping: room name Wohnzimmer with notify entity notify.living_room. See setup guide.

sources.title: Data sources and reminders
sources.description: All sources are optional. Select existing entities; empty fields stay disabled. Reminders are shared. An Echo room is optional.

data.shopping: Shopping list (Bring! or other to-do list)
data.learning_enabled: Optional learning for generic home-data questions

data_description.restmuell: ISO YYYY-MM-DD state or date-key attributes.
data_description.guenstig: Price sensor with a timestamp attribute for tomorrow.
data_description.solar: Use an aggregate sensor for multiple arrays.
data_description.reminders_enabled: One active reminder. HA notification, including after restart.
data_description.reminder_room: One configured room only. Audio may use public short-lived links; no confidential content.
data_description.learning_enabled: Off by default. Only generic unmatched home-data questions from a restricted vocabulary; suggestions in RAM for 24 hours, admin approval required.
